## Where do actuaries work (Australia)?

```{=html}
<!--
  Headline stat with one supporting bar chart, from the Actuaries Institute
  member figures (full table on the backup slide "Where do Actuaries work?").
  Bars show the share of members who list each area as a SECONDARY area of
  work; Data Science & AI is highlighted. Hover a bar for members and primary %.
-->
<div class="wa">
  <div class="wa-hero">
    <div class="wa-big">1 in 3</div>
    <div class="wa-text">actuaries also work in <b>data science &amp; AI</b></div>
    <div class="wa-sub">35% list it as at least a secondary area of work.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="wa-chart">
    <div class="wa-title">Share of actuaries in each area of (primary and secondary) work</div>
    <div class="wa-rows" data-out="rows"></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="wa-source">Source: <a href="https://www.actuaries.asn.au/about-us/year-in-review-and-financial-statements">Actuaries Institute, Year in review</a></div>

<style>
.reveal .wa {
  --wa-gold: #be830e;
  --wa-bar: #8a97a6;
  --wa-line: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  --wa-line: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent);
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr; gap: 40px; align-items: center;
  text-align: left; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.reveal .wa .wa-big { font-size: 2.8em; font-weight: 700; color: var(--wa-gold); line-height: 1; }
.reveal .wa .wa-text { font-size: 0.95em; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 0.3em; }
.reveal .wa .wa-text b { font-weight: 700; }
.reveal .wa .wa-sub { font-size: 0.65em; opacity: 0.75; margin-top: 0.8em; line-height: 1.4; }
.reveal .wa .wa-title { font-size: 0.55em; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.reveal .wa .wa-rows { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10em 1fr 3em; column-gap: 12px; row-gap: 4px; font-size: 0.58em; }
.reveal .wa .wa-lab { align-self: center; text-align: right; }
.reveal .wa .wa-lab.is-hi, .reveal .wa .wa-val.is-hi { font-weight: 700; }
.reveal .wa .wa-track { position: relative; height: 30px; }
.reveal .wa .wa-bar {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 4px; bottom: 4px;
  background: var(--wa-bar); border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
}
.reveal .wa .wa-bar.is-hi { background: var(--wa-gold); }
.reveal .wa .wa-track:hover .wa-bar { filter: brightness(0.9); }
.reveal .wa .wa-val { align-self: center; }
.reveal .wa-source { font-size: 0.5em; opacity: 0.7; margin-top: 0.8em; text-align: left; }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  // [area, members, primary %, secondary %]
  var data = [
    ['General insurance', 1807, 31, 45], ['Life insurance', 1375, 24, 37], ['Data Science & AI', 443, 8, 35],
    ['Superannuation', 332, 6, 17], ['Investment', 273, 5, 21], ['Banking', 229, 4, 14],
    ['Health insurance', 187, 3, 15], ['Reinsurance', 171, 3, 18], ['Risk', 139, 2, 21], ['Finance', 101, 2, 16]
  ];
  var HIGHLIGHT = 'Data Science & AI';
  document.querySelectorAll('.wa:not([data-ready])').forEach(function (root) {
    root.dataset.ready = '1';
    var rows = root.querySelector('[data-out="rows"]');
    var max = 50;
    data.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return b[3] - a[3]; }).forEach(function (d) {
      var hi = d[0] === HIGHLIGHT ? ' is-hi' : '';
      var tip = d[0] + ': secondary area for ' + d[3] + '% of actuaries; main area for ' + d[2] + '% (' + d[1].toLocaleString('en-AU') + ' members)';
      rows.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
        '<div class="wa-lab' + hi + '">' + d[0].replace('&', '&amp;') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="wa-track" title="' + tip.replace('&', '&amp;') + '"><div class="wa-bar' + hi + '" style="width:' + (100 * d[3]) / max + '%"></div></div>' +
        '<div class="wa-val' + hi + '">' + d[3] + '%</div>');
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```

::: {.notes}
About 2 min. The surprise is data science and AI: actuaries are data people. General and life insurance are still the biggest areas. The full member table is in the backup slides.
:::
